description: Which records describe which real-world farm. National-to-EMODnet links are read from ../location-mapping.json (the existing exercise crosswalk). ODP carries the EMODnet records, so an ODP record is linked by its identical EMODnet name. Every EMODnet site not linked to a national project becomes a farm of its own. OSM links are declared here: elements by id, turbines by a rule.
